resource.name: Check whether the client can be accommodated
resource.description: *Business process* (F) Referral: Activity: Check whether the client can be accommodated: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To be able the check if the supplies and skills needed to accommodate a referred client are available at my facility so that >I can validate to the referring facility (or directly to the client) where the client can be accommodated

resource.name: Analyse and interpret the reports
resource.description: *Business process* (G) Aggregate reporting and data use: Activity: Analyse and interpret the reports: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To view a range of standardized visualizations (e.g. charts, tables, maps) so that >I am able to use data collected at the facility for service delivery and informing programmatic actions with the aim of improving the quality of care for clients with TB

resource.name: Assess medical history and risk factors
resource.description: *Business process* (B) Screening: Activity: Assess medical history and risk factors: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To be able to capture or update client information related to medical history and risk factors for TB so that >I make sure that new relevant information is not missed

resource.name: Assess medical history and risk factors
resource.description: *Business process* (C) Diagnosis: Activity: Assess medical history and risk factors: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To be able to route the consultation via different health workers and save in the system the information already entered to the consultation even if the consultation is not yet complete, enabling other health workers to see the information already entered and to be able to add or edit information as it becomes available so that >I do not have to start a new consultation for every health worker that the client is involved with

resource.name: Carry out clinical examination
resource.description: *Business process* (C) Diagnosis: Activity: Carry out clinical examination: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >The system to use the data entered for a client to generate statistics, graphs, pop-ups (on demand or ad hoc) so that >I can take better clinical decisions

resource.name: Check in the client
resource.description: *Business process* (A) Registration: Activity: Check in the client: As a Health worker or data entry clerk or medical office receptionist, I want to: >The system to record a time-and-date-stamped new contact (encounter) so that >I can confirm when the client came

resource.name: Check in the client
resource.description: *Business process* (A) Registration: Activity: Check in the client: As a Health worker or data entry clerk or medical office receptionist, I want to: >Provide a list of scheduled contacts to allow clients that are on TB preventive treatment or TB treatment who are lost to follow-up to be traced so that >I can track and follow up clients requiring TB care services

resource.name: Check in the client
resource.description: *Business process* (A) Registration: Activity: Check in the client: As a Health worker or data entry clerk or medical office receptionist, I want to: >Provide a list or roster of all clients due to arrive so that >I know which clients to follow up or are due for services

resource.name: Contact referral facility
resource.description: *Business process* (F) Referral: Activity: Contact referral facility: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To be able to send a referral request to a health centre so that >I can refer my client for them to receive the appropriate services

resource.name: Contact referral facility
resource.description: *Business process* (F) Referral: Activity: Contact referral facility: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To have a list of the contact information for referral facilities so that >I can easily contact the facility when making the referral arrangements

resource.name: Create a new client record
resource.description: *Business process* (A) Registration: Activity: Create a new client record: As a Health worker or data entry clerk or medical office receptionist, I want to: >To be able to enter identification information so that >I can enter new client information

resource.name: Create a new client record
resource.description: *Business process* (A) Registration: Activity: Create a new client record: As a Health worker or data entry clerk or medical office receptionist, I want to: >The system to indicate mandatory fields that must be filled out for the registration to be valid so that >I can ensure all necessary information has been completed

resource.name: Create a new client record
resource.description: *Business process* (A) Registration: Activity: Create a new client record: As a Health worker or data entry clerk or medical office receptionist, I want to: >To generate a facility medical record number so that >I can check and confirm the information

resource.name: Create a new client record
resource.description: *Business process* (A) Registration: Activity: Create a new client record: As a Health worker or data entry clerk or medical office receptionist, I want to: >To edit fields on screen before information is committed so that >I can ensure information has been checked before submission

resource.name: Create a new client record
resource.description: *Business process* (A) Registration: Activity: Create a new client record: As a Health worker or data entry clerk or medical office receptionist, I want to: >To enter a temporary identification in situations when full identity is unknown so that >I can proceed with registration and update the information later on, once identity information is provided

resource.name: Determine the regimen designed to treat rifampicin-resistant TB
resource.description: *Business process* (D) TB Treatment: Activity: Determine the regimen designed to treat rifampicin-resistant TB: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >The system to propose TB treatment regimens based on predefined criteria and on the information available in the system so that >It helps me selecting the appropriate treatment regimen for the client

resource.name: Determine the regimen designed to treat rifampicin-resistant TB
resource.description: *Business process* (D) TB Treatment: Activity: Determine the regimen designed to treat rifampicin-resistant TB: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To be alerted if a client is allergic to TB-related medications (specify the drugs) so that >I immediately know that I cannot prescribe these drugs and client safety is better protected

resource.name: Determine the screening algorithm
resource.description: *Business process* (B) Screening: Activity: Determine the screening algorithm: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To have available general information about screening algorithms so that >I have a quick reference to help me choose the most appropriate screening algorithm for a client or group of clients

resource.name: Determine TPT eligibility
resource.description: *Business process* (E) TB preventive treatment (TPT): Activity: Determine TPT eligibility: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To have questions that guide me in TPT eligibility assessment so that >I can better evaluate client TPT eligibility

resource.name: Determine TPT eligibility
resource.description: *Business process* (E) TB preventive treatment (TPT): Activity: Determine TPT eligibility: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To be able to use my clinical judgement when deciding if a client is eligible or not for TPT and enter the decision in the system so that >I do not prevent clients from taking TPT when they are eligible with clinical judgement (e.g. when the benefits of TPT outweighs the risks)

resource.name: Determine whether TB infection testing is relevant
resource.description: *Business process* (E) TB preventive treatment (TPT): Activity: Determine whether TB infection testing is relevant: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To have available general information about TB infection testing so that >I will not have to look elsewhere to find information

resource.name: Develop monitoring examinations and a schedule of follow-up visits
resource.description: *Business process* (D) TB Treatment: Activity: Develop monitoring examinations and a schedule of follow-up visits: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To have the system automatically calculate a date when the client should return for care, based on treatment regimen, clinical condition and monitoring examinations so that >I do not have to calculate this myself

resource.name: Generate aggregate reports
resource.description: *Business process* (G) Aggregate reporting and data use: Activity: Generate aggregate reports: As a Health worker or data entry clerk, I want to: >To produce a range of prepared reports so that >I do not need to create the reports manually for reporting purposes

resource.name: Identify and discuss referral location options
resource.description: *Business process* (F) Referral: Activity: Identify and discuss referral location options: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To be able to find out in the system where the required service may be available so that >I can refer my client to another facility to receive the appropriate services

resource.name: Initiate the treatment and discuss adherence
resource.description: *Business process* (D) TB Treatment: Activity: Initiate the treatment and discuss adherence: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >The system to automatically calculate the expected TB treatment completion date so that >I do not have to calculate this myself

resource.name: Initiate TPT and develop an adherence plan
resource.description: *Business process* (E) TB preventive treatment (TPT): Activity: Initiate TPT and develop an adherence plan: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To have available general information about TPT adherence so that >I can better prepare the TPT adherence plan

resource.name: Interpret the follow-on test(s) results
resource.description: *Business process* (C) Diagnosis: Activity: Interpret the follow-on test(s) results: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >The system to be capable to receive diagnosis test results from laboratories or other test centres so that >I can take the appropriate actions more quickly

resource.name: Make an informed decision
resource.description: *Business process* (E) TB preventive treatment (TPT): Activity: Make an informed decision: As a Health information officer, I want to: >The system to prompt the health worker to get informed consent from the client before proceeding with the TPT evaluation so that >I can ensure that client rights are protected

resource.name: Manage TB treatment interruptions
resource.description: *Business process* (D) TB Treatment: Activity: Manage TB treatment interruptions: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >The system to be able to exchange information with digital adherence technologies to automatically record and calculate information related to treatment progress or interruptions so that >I do not have to calculate this myself and fill in the information manually

resource.name: Offer TB prevention counselling
resource.description: *Business process* (E) TB preventive treatment (TPT): Activity: Offer TB prevention counselling: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To be prompted to provide counselling on TPT so that >I can ensure that the client is educated on TPT before offering any TPT-related service

resource.name: Perform the clinical assessment
resource.description: *Business process* (D) TB Treatment: Activity: Perform the clinical assessment: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >The system to trigger an alert when a client did not show-up on the intended follow-up day, according to the follow-up schedule so that >I could follow up the client in a timely manner to prevent them from being lost to follow-up

resource.name: Perform the TB screening
resource.description: *Business process* (B) Screening: Activity: Perform the TB screening: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To be able to send referral letters via appropriate digital tools (e.g. email, digital health portal) so that >I can speed up the referral process and check-in at the accommodating health-care facility

resource.name: Provide information to the receiving facility
resource.description: *Business process* (F) Referral: Activity: Provide information to the receiving facility: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To indicate in the system the referral reason so that >I can identify ways to improve the TB care process at my health-care facility

resource.name: Provide information to the receiving facility
resource.description: *Business process* (F) Referral: Activity: Provide information to the receiving facility: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To share the client’s health records with the referral facility  so that >They can provide the care my client needs

resource.name: Provide pre-screening information and ask for consent
resource.description: *Business process* (B) Screening: Activity: Provide pre-screening information and ask for consent: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To have available general pre-screening information about potential risks and benefits, screening tools and procedure to share with clients during counselling activities so that >I can better answer the client’s questions and better prepare them for screening activities

resource.name: Provide pre-screening information and ask for consent
resource.description: *Business process* (B) Screening: Activity: Provide pre-screening information and ask for consent: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >The system to prompt the health worker to get informed consent from the client before proceeding with screening so that >I can ensure that ethical principles for screening for infectious diseases are followed and that the clients’ rights are protected

resource.name: Receive the client
resource.description: *Business process* (F) Referral: Activity: Receive the client: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To know what care the client received at the referral facility  so that >I can provide appropriate care if my client comes back to my facility

resource.name: Report the outcome(s)
resource.description: *Business process* (D) TB Treatment: Activity: Report the outcome(s): As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >The system to trigger an alert to assign treatment outcome in case the expected TB treatment completion date is reached and there is no treatment outcome assigned so that >Alignment between the number of cases notified and number of treatment outcome cohort (all notified cases have assigned treatment outcomes) is ensured

resource.name: Schedule the follow-up visit
resource.description: *Business process* (E) TB preventive treatment (TPT): Activity: Schedule the follow-up visit: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To be able to indicate if the client agrees to receive notifications and their preferred communication channel (including sending reminders for the next follow-up visit) so that >I can send communications via the client's preferred communication channel

resource.name: Search for the client record
resource.description: *Business process* (A) Registration: Activity: Search for the client record: As a Health worker or data entry clerk or medical office receptionist, I want to: >To search to see whether client is already in the system (using at least two identifiers) so that >I can check whether this is a new or existing client

resource.name: Search for the client record
resource.description: *Business process* (A) Registration: Activity: Search for the client record: As a Health worker or data entry clerk or medical office receptionist, I want to: >The system to be able to work offline so that >I can carry on the TB care service provision regardless of an Internet connection. Once the system goes back online, the data are synchronized with the central system

resource.name: Search for the client record
resource.description: *Business process* (A) Registration: Activity: Search for the client record: As a Health worker or data entry clerk or medical office receptionist, I want to: >The system to display sufficient data to identify the client so that >I can confirm that it is the correct client

resource.name: Search for the client record
resource.description: *Business process* (A) Registration: Activity: Search for the client record: As a Health worker or data entry clerk or medical office receptionist, I want to: >The system to require me (a user) to search to see whether a client is already in the system before starting a new medical record entry so that >I can avoid duplicates and update information as necessary

resource.name: Search for the client record
resource.description: *Business process* (A) Registration: Activity: Search for the client record: As a Health worker or data entry clerk or medical office receptionist, I want to: >To use the client identification system (e.g. quick response [QR] code, barcode, fingerprint) and pull up client information so that >I can confirm that it is the correct client and update the information as necessary

resource.name: Search for the client record
resource.description: *Business process* (A) Registration: Activity: Search for the client record: As a Health worker or data entry clerk or medical office receptionist, I want to: >To provide sufficient data to rule out the possibility that this client is already in the system so that >I can avoid duplicates

resource.name: Stabilize the client and give pre-referral treatment
resource.description: *Business process* (F) Referral: Activity: Stabilize the client and give pre-referral treatment: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To be able to bypass the standard flow at any point if danger signs are present or emergency care is needed; urgent cases should be flagged and seen promptly so that >The client can be referred, if needed

resource.name: Validate the client details
resource.description: *Business process* (A) Registration: Activity: Validate the client details: As a Health worker or data entry clerk or medical office receptionist, I want to: >To display client information for validation (and be able to edit it) so that >I can ensure information has been checked before submission

resource.name: Validate the client details
resource.description: *Business process* (A) Registration: Activity: Validate the client details: As a Health worker or data entry clerk or medical office receptionist, I want to: >To be able to update demographic information so that >The most current information about the client can be recorded

resource.name: Validate the client details
resource.description: *Business process* (A) Registration: Activity: Validate the client details: As a Health worker or data entry clerk or medical office receptionist, I want to: >The system to retain previous history of updated information so that >I can review past information

resource.name: Validate the client details
resource.description: *Business process* (A) Registration: Activity: Validate the client details: As a Health worker or data entry clerk or medical office receptionist, I want to: >To be able to attach an identifier (e.g. QR code, barcode, fingerprint, photo) to the client's record based on national standard-based consent so that >I have additional ways of identifying client

resource.name: Validate the client details
resource.description: *Business process* (A) Registration: Activity: Validate the client details: As a Health worker or data entry clerk or medical office receptionist, I want to: >To be able to confirm the client's identity so that >I can be sure it is the right person

resource.name: Validate the client details
resource.description: *Business process* (A) Registration: Activity: Validate the client details: As a Health worker or data entry clerk or medical office receptionist, I want to: >If this is a returning contact, to add the information to their previous contact so that >I can link the information across different contacts

resource.description: *Business process* (A) Registration: Activity: Check in the client: As a Health worker or data entry clerk or medical office receptionist, I want to: >Provide a list or roster of all clients due to arrive so that >I know which clients to follow up or are due for services

resource.name: LM.TB.FXNREQ.021.B
resource.description: *Business process* (B) Screening: Activity: Provide pre-screening information and ask for consent: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To have available general pre-screening information about potential risks and benefits, screening tools and procedure to share with clients during counselling activities so that >I can better answer the client’s questions and better prepare them for screening activities

resource.name: LM.TB.FXNREQ.022.B
resource.description: *Business process* (B) Screening: Activity: Provide pre-screening information and ask for consent: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >The system to prompt the health worker to get informed consent from the client before proceeding with screening so that >I can ensure that ethical principles for screening for infectious diseases are followed and that the clients’ rights are protected

resource.name: LM.TB.FXNREQ.023.B
resource.description: *Business process* (B) Screening: Activity: Assess medical history and risk factors: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To be able to capture or update client information related to medical history and risk factors for TB so that >I make sure that new relevant information is not missed

resource.name: LM.TB.FXNREQ.024.B
resource.description: *Business process* (B) Screening: Activity: Determine the screening algorithm: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To have available general information about screening algorithms so that >I have a quick reference to help me choose the most appropriate screening algorithm for a client or group of clients

resource.name: LM.TB.FXNREQ.025.B
resource.description: *Business process* (B) Screening: Activity: Perform the TB screening: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To be able to send referral letters via appropriate digital tools (e.g. email, digital health portal) so that >I can speed up the referral process and check-in at the accommodating health-care facility

resource.name: LM.TB.FXNREQ.026.C
resource.description: *Business process* (C) Diagnosis: Activity: Carry out clinical examination: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >The system to use the data entered for a client to generate statistics, graphs, pop-ups (on demand or ad hoc) so that >I can take better clinical decisions

resource.name: LM.TB.FXNREQ.027.C
resource.description: *Business process* (C) Diagnosis: Activity: Assess medical history and risk factors: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To be able to route the consultation via different health workers and save in the system the information already entered to the consultation even if the consultation is not yet complete, enabling other health workers to see the information already entered and to be able to add or edit information as it becomes available so that >I do not have to start a new consultation for every health worker that the client is involved with

resource.name: LM.TB.FXNREQ.028.C
resource.description: *Business process* (C) Diagnosis: Activity: C4 Assess history of prior TB treatment: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To be able to check client's medical history so that >I can use this information for investigations or treatment recommendations

resource.name: LM.TB.FXNREQ.029.C
resource.description: *Business process* (C) Diagnosis: Activity: Interpret the follow-on test(s) results: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >The system to be capable to receive diagnosis test results from laboratories or other test centres so that >I can take the appropriate actions more quickly

resource.name: LM.TB.FXNREQ.030.D
resource.description: *Business process* (D) TB Treatment: Activity: Determine the regimen designed to treat rifampicin-resistant TB: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >The system to propose TB treatment regimens based on predefined criteria and on the information available in the system so that >It helps me selecting the appropriate treatment regimen for the client

resource.name: LM.TB.FXNREQ.031.D
resource.description: *Business process* (D) TB Treatment: Activity: Determine the regimen designed to treat rifampicin-resistant TB: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To be alerted if a client is allergic to TB-related medications (specify the drugs) so that >I immediately know that I cannot prescribe these drugs and client safety is better protected

resource.name: LM.TB.FXNREQ.032.D
resource.description: *Business process* (D) TB Treatment: Activity: Initiate the treatment and discuss adherence: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >The system to automatically calculate the expected TB treatment completion date so that >I do not have to calculate this myself

resource.name: LM.TB.FXNREQ.033.D
resource.description: *Business process* (D) TB Treatment: Activity: Develop monitoring examinations and a schedule of follow-up visits: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To have the system automatically calculate a date when the client should return for care, based on treatment regimen, clinical condition and monitoring examinations so that >I do not have to calculate this myself

resource.name: LM.TB.FXNREQ.034.D
resource.description: *Business process* (D) TB Treatment: Activity: Perform the clinical assessment: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >The system to trigger an alert when a client did not show-up on the intended follow-up day, according to the follow-up schedule so that >I could follow up the client in a timely manner to prevent them from being lost to follow-up

resource.name: LM.TB.FXNREQ.035.D
resource.description: *Business process* (D) TB Treatment: Activity: Manage TB treatment interruptions: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >The system to be able to exchange information with digital adherence technologies to automatically record and calculate information related to treatment progress or interruptions so that >I do not have to calculate this myself and fill in the information manually

resource.name: LM.TB.FXNREQ.036.D
resource.description: *Business process* (D) TB Treatment: Activity: Report the outcome(s): As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >The system to trigger an alert to assign treatment outcome in case the expected TB treatment completion date is reached and there is no treatment outcome assigned so that >Alignment between the number of cases notified and number of treatment outcome cohort (all notified cases have assigned treatment outcomes) is ensured

resource.name: LM.TB.FXNREQ.037.E
resource.description: *Business process* (E) TB preventive treatment (TPT): Activity: Offer TB prevention counselling: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To be prompted to provide counselling on TPT so that >I can ensure that the client is educated on TPT before offering any TPT-related service

resource.name: LM.TB.FXNREQ.038.E
resource.description: *Business process* (E) TB preventive treatment (TPT): Activity: Make an informed decision: As a Health information officer, I want to: >The system to prompt the health worker to get informed consent from the client before proceeding with the TPT evaluation so that >I can ensure that client rights are protected

resource.name: LM.TB.FXNREQ.039.E
resource.description: *Business process* (E) TB preventive treatment (TPT): Activity: Determine whether TB infection testing is relevant: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To have available general information about TB infection testing so that >I will not have to look elsewhere to find information

resource.name: LM.TB.FXNREQ.040.E
resource.description: *Business process* (E) TB preventive treatment (TPT): Activity: Determine TPT eligibility: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To have questions that guide me in TPT eligibility assessment so that >I can better evaluate client TPT eligibility

resource.name: LM.TB.FXNREQ.041.E
resource.description: *Business process* (E) TB preventive treatment (TPT): Activity: Determine TPT eligibility: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To be able to use my clinical judgement when deciding if a client is eligible or not for TPT and enter the decision in the system so that >I do not prevent clients from taking TPT when they are eligible with clinical judgement (e.g. when the benefits of TPT outweighs the risks)

resource.name: LM.TB.FXNREQ.042.E
resource.description: *Business process* (E) TB preventive treatment (TPT): Activity: Initiate TPT and develop an adherence plan: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To have available general information about TPT adherence so that >I can better prepare the TPT adherence plan

resource.name: LM.TB.FXNREQ.043.E
resource.description: *Business process* (E) TB preventive treatment (TPT): Activity: Schedule the follow-up visit: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To be able to indicate if the client agrees to receive notifications and their preferred communication channel (including sending reminders for the next follow-up visit) so that >I can send communications via the client's preferred communication channel

resource.name: LM.TB.FXNREQ.044.F
resource.description: *Business process* (F) Referral: Activity: Stabilize the client and give pre-referral treatment: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To be able to bypass the standard flow at any point if danger signs are present or emergency care is needed; urgent cases should be flagged and seen promptly so that >The client can be referred, if needed

resource.name: LM.TB.FXNREQ.045.F
resource.description: *Business process* (F) Referral: Activity: Identify and discuss referral location options: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To be able to find out in the system where the required service may be available so that >I can refer my client to another facility to receive the appropriate services

resource.name: LM.TB.FXNREQ.046.F
resource.description: *Business process* (F) Referral: Activity: Contact referral facility: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To be able to send a referral request to a health centre so that >I can refer my client for them to receive the appropriate services

resource.name: LM.TB.FXNREQ.047.F
resource.description: *Business process* (F) Referral: Activity: Contact referral facility: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To have a list of the contact information for referral facilities so that >I can easily contact the facility when making the referral arrangements

resource.name: LM.TB.FXNREQ.048.F
resource.description: *Business process* (F) Referral: Activity: Provide information to the receiving facility: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To indicate in the system the referral reason so that >I can identify ways to improve the TB care process at my health-care facility

resource.name: LM.TB.FXNREQ.049.F
resource.description: *Business process* (F) Referral: Activity: Provide information to the receiving facility: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To share the client’s health records with the referral facility  so that >They can provide the care my client needs

resource.name: LM.TB.FXNREQ.050.F
resource.description: *Business process* (F) Referral: Activity: Check whether the client can be accommodated: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To be able the check if the supplies and skills needed to accommodate a referred client are available at my facility so that >I can validate to the referring facility (or directly to the client) where the client can be accommodated

resource.name: LM.TB.FXNREQ.051.F
resource.description: *Business process* (F) Referral: Activity: Receive the client: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To know what care the client received at the referral facility  so that >I can provide appropriate care if my client comes back to my facility

resource.name: LM.TB.FXNREQ.052.G
resource.description: *Business process* (G) Aggregate reporting and data use: Activity: Generate aggregate reports: As a Health worker or data entry clerk, I want to: >To produce a range of prepared reports so that >I do not need to create the reports manually for reporting purposes

resource.name: LM.TB.FXNREQ.053.G
resource.description: *Business process* (G) Aggregate reporting and data use: Activity: Analyse and interpret the reports: As a Health worker (e.g. nurse), I want to: >To view a range of standardized visualizations (e.g. charts, tables, maps) so that >I am able to use data collected at the facility for service delivery and informing programmatic actions with the aim of improving the quality of care for clients with TB
